transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because everybody keeps acting like I'm imagining it. But I'm not. 

I know my wife's relative came into this house to get at me. I mean... my tools don't move themselves. And my fishing plans don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. I don't really want to get into all of it, but... after all these months, I can see plain as day he's been trying to take over my place. Push me out. 

That's it, really.
Besides these beliefs about your wife's relative, have you been hearing, seeing, or smelling anything that other people around you do not seem to notice?
No. ... I don't hear things, if that's what you mean. Nothing like that. Just... just what I already told you.
Are you currently taking any prescription medications, or have you had any recent changes to your physical health?
No. I don't take anything. ... My health is fine. There's nothing wrong with me physically, if that's what you're getting at.
Have you ever had any head injuries, seizures, or sudden changes in your memory or personality?
No. ... I haven't had any head injuries or anything like that. No seizures. My memory is fine. ... I'm exactly the same as I've always been.
How long have you felt that your wife's relative has been trying to take over your home?
About nine months. ... Ever since they moved into our house. That's when it started.
Over the past nine months, have you experienced any significant periods where your mood felt unusually low or, conversely, where you felt unusually energetic and didn't need much sleep?
No. ... My mood is fine. I sleep regular hours. I just... I go to work, I come home. There's no issues with my energy or anything like that. I'm just normal.
Aside from your concerns about your wife's relative, have you been able to maintain your normal routine at work and with your daily responsibilities?
Yeah. I still go to work. I get up, go to the plant, do my assembler job... pay the bills. I take care of myself just fine. It's just... the problem is at home. With him. And my things. That's all.
Have you ever asked your wife or anyone else who doesn't live in your house if they have seen any evidence of this relative moving your tools or interfering with your plans?
No. I haven't asked anyone else. There's no point. My wife doesn't see it, or she pretends she doesn't. And I don't... I don't talk to other people about my house. It's my business.
Do you feel that anyone else outside of your house is involved in this situation with your wife's relative?
No. Just him. I don't... nobody else comes around. It's just him.
Do you feel that this relative is using any sort of special technology, hidden devices, or supernatural powers to move your tools or interfere with your life?

No. I don't... no. Nothing like that. 

He just walks in and does it. He doesn't need any special gadgets or... whatever you said, to mess with my things. He just uses his hands.
